candidates.summary: The latest unauthorized agent swarms were discovered by researchers.

candidates.title: Build a multi-account AI agent with AgentCore Gateway and MCP
candidates.summary: Build a multi-account architecture that keeps each team's data in its own AWS account while giving AI agents a unified way to query across them. A central platform account runs the agent using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway and MCP, while line-of-business accounts expose their data as MCP servers with secure cross-account access and fine-grained authorization.

candidates.title: How Datacor built self-service rental analytics with Amazon Quick Sight
candidates.summary: Learn how Datacor built a self-service rental analytics experience for gas and welding distributors by embedding Amazon Quick Sight dashboards and natural language querying into its TrackAbout platform, powered by an automated cross-cloud data pipeline and multi-tenant row-level security.

candidates.title: Anthropic’s founders seek voting control ahead of IPO
candidates.summary: Anthropic is asking its shareholders to approve a structure that would give its seven co-founders a combined 50.1% of the vote on most corporate matters.
